senses.zh: sớm; thuở đầu; ở giai đoạn đầu
senses.en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time
Before the expected time or near the beginning

ex.en: We caught an early train and arrived before breakfast.
Early investment in childhood education can reduce inequality and improve employment prospects later in life.

tip: early vừa là tính từ vừa là trạng từ, không thêm -ly.

senses.en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things.

senses.zh: những người này; những thứ này
senses.en: Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.

ex.en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.

col: in these circumstances｜trong những trường hợp này
tip: these là số nhiều của this, theo sau là danh từ số nhiều.

senses.en: liked more than any other of the same kind

senses.zh: người hoặc vật được yêu thích nhất
senses.en: a person or thing someone likes best
the competitor considered most likely to win

ex.en: This little bakery sells my favourite kind of bread.
Public libraries allow readers to discover new authors as well as revisit their favourite books without additional cost.

col: favourite subject｜môn học yêu thích nhất
a firm favourite｜người hoặc vật luôn được yêu thích
the favourite to win｜ứng viên vô địch sáng giá
tip: Tiếng Anh-Anh viết favourite, tiếng Anh-Mỹ viết favorite; thường không dùng most để bổ nghĩa.

senses.zh: người lớn; con vật trưởng thành
senses.en: A person or animal that has finished growing.

senses.zh: trưởng thành; dành cho người lớn
senses.en: Fully grown, or relating to grown people.

ex.en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.

col: adult life｜cuộc sống người trưởng thành
responsible adult｜người lớn có trách nhiệm
tip: Vừa là danh từ đếm được vừa là tính từ, như adult education.

senses.en: a device that shows the time

senses.zh: đo tốc độ; ghi thời gian
senses.en: to measure or record the time or speed of something

ex.en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.

col: watch the clock｜nhìn đồng hồ chờ tan làm
tip: clock thường là đồng hồ để bàn hoặc treo tường; đồng hồ đeo tay là watch.

senses.zh: ở tầng dưới; xuống tầng dưới
senses.en: On or towards a lower floor of a building
Located on a lower floor of a building

ex.en: I went downstairs when I smelled fresh bread.
Providing a downstairs bedroom can help older residents remain independent in their own homes.

tip: Làm trạng từ thì nói thẳng go downstairs, không thêm to.

senses.en: Facts or details about someone or something

ex.en: The receptionist gave us useful information about local buses.
Access to reliable information enables patients to make better decisions about their treatment and long-term health.

col: reliable information｜thông tin đáng tin cậy
a piece of information｜một thông tin
tip: Không đếm được: nói some information, không nói an information.

senses.en: A dark classroom board used for writing or drawing with chalk.

ex.en: Our teacher drew a huge circle on the blackboard.
Although digital screens offer interactive features, a traditional blackboard remains an affordable teaching tool for many schools.

col: write on the blackboard｜viết lên bảng
tip: Trên bảng dùng on the blackboard; dùng cùng phấn.

senses.en: A social gathering where people celebrate or enjoy themselves.
An organised group seeking political power through shared policies.
A person or group involved in an agreement or dispute.

ex.en: We held a small party in the garden yesterday.
Each political party should explain how its education policies will benefit students from disadvantaged backgrounds.

tip: party trong hợp đồng chỉ bên liên quan, không phải bữa tiệc hay đảng phái.

senses.en: An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.

ex.en: Dad cooked a warm meal after our long walk.
Providing healthy school meals can improve children's concentration and support their physical development.

col: balanced meal｜bữa ăn cân bằng dinh dưỡng
prepare a meal｜chuẩn bị bữa ăn
tip: meal là một bữa ăn; food chỉ thức ăn nói chung, thường không đếm được.

senses.en: a seat for one person, usually with a back
the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee
to lead a meeting and manage its discussion

ex.en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.

col: chair a meeting｜chủ trì cuộc họp
tip: Khi là động từ, chair theo sau trực tiếp là meeting, nghĩa là chủ trì cuộc họp.

senses.zh: không bao giờ; chưa bao giờ
senses.en: Not at any time.
Certainly not, used to express strong refusal or intention.

ex.en: I never leave home without my water bottle.
Public transport can never fully replace walking and cycling as accessible forms of daily exercise.

col: almost never｜hầu như không bao giờ
tip: Thường đứng trước động từ thường, sau động từ be hoặc trợ động từ.

senses.en: The central part, point, or position of something
Located between other things or between the beginning and end

ex.en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
Housing costs often force essential workers to live far from the middle of the cities they serve.

tip: Danh từ thường dùng the middle of; tính từ bổ nghĩa trực tiếp cho danh từ.

senses.en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way
calm and able to think clearly under pressure
to become or make something less hot

ex.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.

col: cool down｜nguội đi; bình tĩnh lại
tip: cool nhẹ hơn cold; trong khẩu ngữ còn có nghĩa là “ngầu”.

senses.en: The month after August and before October.

ex.en: Our evening photography course starts in September this year.
In many countries, the academic year begins in September, creating seasonal demand for student accommodation near universities.

tip: Tên tháng viết hoa chữ cái đầu; dùng in September, nhưng next September không dùng in.

senses.en: Not difficult and requiring little effort.
Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.

ex.en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.

col: easy access to｜dễ tiếp cận hoặc dễ đến
tip: Thường dùng easy to do; bổ nghĩa cho hành động thì dùng easily.

senses.en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified
an action, event, fact, or situation
possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.

col: the right thing to do｜điều đúng đắn nên làm
first thing in the morning｜việc đầu tiên vào buổi sáng
one thing at a time｜mỗi lần một việc
tip: thing rất chung chung; trong văn viết trang trọng nên thay bằng danh từ cụ thể.

senses.en: the opening in your face used for eating and speaking
the opening of a cave or where a river meets the sea

senses.zh: mấp máy môi không thành tiếng
senses.en: to form words with your lips without making a sound

ex.en: The dentist asked me to open my mouth wider.
Wetlands near the mouth of a river provide valuable habitats and help protect coastal communities from flooding.

col: the mouth of a river｜cửa sông
tip: Danh từ có âm cuối /θ/; động từ có âm cuối /ð/.

senses.en: Spend time learning about or carefully examining a subject.
The activity of learning, or an investigation of a subject.

senses.zh: phòng làm việc; phòng đọc sách
senses.en: A room used for reading, writing, or working.

ex.en: I study English on the bus every morning.
A recent study suggests that regular exercise can improve students' concentration during classroom activities.

col: a recent study｜một nghiên cứu gần đây
study for an exam｜học để thi
tip: study nhấn mạnh quá trình học; learn thường nhấn mạnh việc học được hoặc thu nhận kiến thức.

senses.en: Any thing at all, without limits on choice
Something, used especially in questions and conditional statements

ex.en: You can choose anything from this basket of toys.
Before introducing new policies, governments should check whether anything similar has worked successfully elsewhere.

col: anything else｜bất cứ thứ gì khác
anything at all｜bất cứ thứ gì
tip: Trong câu hỏi thường nghĩa là “cái gì”; trong câu khẳng định có thể nghĩa là “bất cứ thứ gì”.

senses.en: someone who takes part in a sport or game
someone who plays a musical instrument
a device or program that plays recorded sound or video

ex.en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.

col: team player｜người biết làm việc nhóm
media player｜trình phát đa phương tiện
tip: Người chơi nhạc cụ có thể dùng “tên nhạc cụ + player”, như piano player.

senses.en: the number equal to four times ten

ex.en: We waited forty minutes before the bus finally arrived.
The survey found that forty percent of local residents preferred cycling to driving for short journeys.

col: in her forties｜ở độ tuổi ngoài bốn mươi của cô ấy
tip: Viết là forty, không phải fourty; ngoài bốn mươi tuổi dùng in one's forties.

senses.en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar.
An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.

col: a bar of chocolate｜một thanh sô-cô-la
a box of chocolates｜một hộp kẹo sô-cô-la
tip: Sô-cô-la làm nguyên liệu thì không đếm được; từng viên kẹo thì đếm được.

senses.en: How big or small someone or something is.
A standard measurement used for clothes and other products.

senses.zh: phân loại theo cỡ; xác định kích cỡ
senses.en: To sort by measurements or make something a particular size.

ex.en: This suitcase is just the right size for weekends.
Reducing class size may allow teachers to provide more individual support to students with learning difficulties.

tip: Hỏi cỡ số dùng What size, không dùng How much size.

senses.en: Limited in size, amount, or degree.
Young and not yet fully grown.
Not very important or serious.

ex.en: Our small kitchen has room for only two chairs.
Even small improvements in home insulation can reduce energy consumption and lower household bills.

tip: Số lượng ít nói a small number of, không nói small people.

senses.en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition
To wear or display something in a noticeable way

ex.en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.

col: take part in sport｜chơi thể thao
team sport｜môn thể thao đồng đội
tip: Nói chung về thể thao, tiếng Anh-Anh thường dùng sport, tiếng Anh-Mỹ thường dùng sports.

senses.en: A formal test of knowledge or ability.

ex.en: I have a maths exam on Friday morning.
Schools should consider practical skills alongside exam results when assessing students' overall progress.

tip: exam là cách nói tắt thông dụng của examination; tham gia thi dùng take.

senses.en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk

senses.zh: dọa nạt; làm cho khiếp sợ
senses.en: to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance

ex.en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
Improving the diet of dairy cows can increase milk production while supporting animal health.

col: be cowed into silence｜bị dọa đến mức không dám lên tiếng
tip: cow là bò cái trưởng thành; cattle là bò nói chung, không nói a cattle.

senses.en: A round object used in games or shaped like one.
A formal social event where people dance.

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.

col: a ball of wool｜một cuộn len
a charity ball｜dạ hội từ thiện
tip: Trước các môn bóng thường không dùng mạo từ, như play football.

senses.zh: bữa ăn ngoài trời; dã ngoại
senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.

tip: Quá khứ của động từ là picnicked, hiện tại phân từ là picnicking.

senses.en: to start happening or start doing something

ex.en: We begin dinner when everyone is sitting at the table.
Schools should begin teaching digital safety early so that children develop responsible habits when using the internet.

col: begin a discussion｜bắt đầu thảo luận
to begin with｜trước hết; ban đầu
tip: Quá khứ began, quá khứ phân từ begun; theo sau có thể là to-infinitive hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: as much or as many as needed
to the degree that is needed
an amount that meets a need

ex.en: We have enough rice to feed everyone tonight.
Many rural schools lack enough resources to provide students with a broad range of subjects.

col: enough to eat｜đủ đồ để ăn
tip: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ thì đặt trước; bổ nghĩa cho tính từ hoặc trạng từ thì đặt sau.

senses.en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.

senses.zh: tầng lớp xã hội; hạng; loại
senses.en: A social group or category sharing particular characteristics.
To place someone or something in a particular category.

ex.en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.

col: be classed as｜được xếp vào loại
tip: in class thường nghĩa là đang trong giờ học; in the class nghĩa là ở trong lớp này.

senses.en: Not many; a small number of countable things.

senses.zh: một số ít người hoặc vật
senses.en: A small number of people or things.

ex.en: There were few customers in the shop this morning.
Few rural communities have access to the specialist medical services available in major cities.

tip: few nghĩa là gần như không có, a few nghĩa là có vài; cả hai đều đi với danh từ đếm được số nhiều.

senses.en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.

col: a developing country｜nước đang phát triển
live in the country｜sống ở nông thôn
tip: Khi nói “nông thôn” thường dùng the country, để phân biệt với nghĩa quốc gia.

senses.en: to know what something means or how it works
to recognise why someone feels or behaves a certain way
to believe something is true based on available information

ex.en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là understood.

senses.en: Stop living.

senses.zh: ngừng hoạt động; dần biến mất
senses.en: Stop working or gradually become weaker and disappear.
A small cube with marked faces, thrown in games.

ex.en: These plants will die if we forget to water them.
Many marine animals die after swallowing plastic waste, highlighting the urgent need to reduce ocean pollution.

col: die of cancer｜chết vì ung thư
die from injuries｜chết vì chấn thương
tip: die là động từ, dead là tính từ, death là danh từ.

senses.en: The fourth month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in April.
The community garden will open in April, giving local residents more opportunities to grow their own vegetables.

tip: Tên tháng viết hoa chữ cái đầu; trước tháng dùng in, trước ngày cụ thể dùng on.

senses.en: Accompanied by another person or thing.
Having or including a particular feature or thing.
Using a particular tool, material, or means.

ex.en: I cooked dinner with my sister last night.
Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.

col: work with someone｜hợp tác với ai
agree with someone｜đồng ý với ai
with the help of｜với sự giúp đỡ của
tip: Sau with là danh từ hoặc đại từ ở dạng tân ngữ, như with me.

senses.en: A flat, usually round dish used for serving food.
A flat piece of metal or another hard material.
To cover an object with a thin layer of metal.

ex.en: She placed a warm pancake on my plate.
Restaurants can reduce food waste by offering smaller plates and allowing customers to request extra portions.

col: a plate of rice｜một đĩa cơm
gold-plated jewellery｜đồ trang sức mạ vàng
tip: plate thường là đĩa nông, bowl là bát sâu lòng hơn.

senses.en: with another person or other people
joined or combined with something else

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.

col: put together｜lắp ráp; sắp xếp gọn gàng
tip: together thường là trạng từ: làm gì cùng nhau dùng động từ cộng together.

senses.en: the day after Friday and before Sunday

ex.en: We usually buy fresh vegetables at the market on Saturday.
Opening public libraries on Saturday allows more working parents to participate in educational activities with their children.

tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu; dùng on Saturday, nhưng this Saturday không dùng on.

senses.en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood.
The colour of chocolate or dark wood.

senses.zh: làm cho vàng nâu; chuyển sang màu nâu
senses.en: To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.

ex.en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.

tip: Khi làm động từ, brown thường dùng trong nấu ăn, chỉ rán hoặc nướng đến khi vàng nâu.

senses.en: to use money to pay for something
to use time doing something or being somewhere

ex.en: We spent all our money on fresh fruit.
Governments should spend more on preventive healthcare to reduce the future costs of treating chronic diseases.

col: spend time doing｜dành thời gian làm...
tip: Dùng spend + thời gian + doing hoặc spend + tiền + on; quá khứ là spent.

senses.en: The season between summer and winter

ex.en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.

tip: Chữ n không đọc; tiếng Anh-Mỹ thường dùng fall cho mùa thu.

senses.en: Make something easier or better for someone.
Support that makes a difficulty or task easier.

ex.en: Could you help me carry these bags upstairs?
Affordable public transport can help residents access jobs and reduce their dependence on cars.

col: help someone with something｜giúp ai làm việc gì
ask for help｜tìm kiếm sự giúp đỡ
tip: Sau help có thể dùng động từ nguyên mẫu hoặc to-infinitive.

senses.en: extending far upwards or positioned far above the ground
greater than usual in amount, degree, or quality
at or to a position far above the ground

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
High housing costs can prevent young adults from living independently, particularly in major urban centres.

tip: high thường chỉ vị trí hoặc mức độ; chiều cao của người dùng tall.

senses.en: A liquid food made by cooking ingredients in water or stock.

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
Community kitchens can provide affordable vegetable soup to help residents access nutritious meals during difficult economic periods.

col: a bowl of soup｜một bát súp
tip: Thường không đếm được; khi gọi món, two soups có thể là hai phần súp.

senses.en: to decide which person or thing you want
to decide to do something rather than something else

ex.en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.

col: choose to do something｜chọn làm việc gì
choose wisely｜chọn một cách khôn ngoan
tip: Quá khứ chose, quá khứ phân từ chosen; theo sau có thể là to do.

senses.en: a recorded story or sequence of moving images for watching

ex.en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
Movies can introduce audiences to unfamiliar cultures, although they sometimes reinforce stereotypes rather than challenge them.

col: go to the movies｜đi xem phim
tip: movie thiên về tiếng Anh-Mỹ, tiếng Anh-Anh thường dùng film; the movies có thể chỉ rạp chiếu phim.

senses.en: To accept that something is true or someone is truthful.
To think that something is likely or correct.
To have confidence or faith in someone or something.

ex.en: I believe you, but your story sounds quite unusual.
Some educators believe that practical experience is just as valuable as academic knowledge in preparing students for employment.

col: believe in yourself｜tin vào bản thân
widely believed｜được nhiều người tin là
tip: believe someone là tin lời ai; believe in someone là tin vào năng lực của ai.

senses.en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods.
Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.

ex.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.

col: train for a marathon｜tập luyện cho cuộc thi marathon
tip: Phương tiện dùng by train; ở trên một chuyến tàu cụ thể dùng on the train.

senses.en: Thin material used for writing, printing, or wrapping.
A publication containing news, usually printed on large sheets.

senses.zh: bài báo khoa học; đề thi
senses.en: An academic article or a written examination.

ex.en: She wrapped the small gift in bright yellow paper.
The university encourages students to submit assignments electronically to reduce paper consumption across its departments.

col: a sheet of paper｜một tờ giấy
tip: Giấy không đếm được, dùng a piece of paper; bài báo khoa học và tờ báo thì đếm được.

senses.en: introduces a condition for something to happen
introduces an indirect question about whether something is true

ex.en: If it rains, we can play indoors instead.
If cities invest in safe cycling routes, more residents may choose bicycles for their daily journeys.

tip: Khi nói về điều kiện tương lai, mệnh đề if thường dùng thì hiện tại đơn.

senses.en: Large in size, amount, or degree.

senses.zh: quan trọng; có ảnh hưởng lớn
senses.en: Important or likely to have a strong effect.

ex.en: We need a big bag for all these towels.
Public transport can make a big difference to air quality in rapidly growing cities.

col: a big difference｜sự khác biệt rất lớn
a big decision｜quyết định quan trọng
a big mistake｜sai lầm nghiêm trọng
tip: big mang tính khẩu ngữ; trong văn viết trang trọng có thể dùng large hoặc major tùy ngữ cảnh.

senses.en: The body part at the arm's end, with fingers and thumb.
Help with doing a task.
To give something to someone by holding it out.

ex.en: She held the warm cup in her left hand.
Practical workshops allow students to develop skills by making objects with their own hands.

col: give someone a hand｜giúp ai một tay
hand in an assignment｜nộp bài tập
tip: give someone a hand là giúp đỡ ai; by hand là làm thủ công.

senses.en: having the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
the colour of lemons or ripe bananas
to become yellow or make something yellow

ex.en: She picked a yellow umbrella for the rainy walk.
Yellow leaves may indicate that urban trees are suffering from water shortages or poor soil conditions.

tip: Có thể làm động từ với nghĩa ngả vàng; không dùng từ này để miêu tả chủng tộc của người.

senses.en: Having a lot of money or valuable possessions.
Containing a large amount or variety of something valuable.
Containing plenty of fat, cream, sugar, or strong flavour.

ex.en: Their rich uncle owns a large house by the sea.
Rich countries can support global development by investing in clean energy projects in poorer regions.

col: rich in nutrients｜giàu chất dinh dưỡng
rich cultural heritage｜di sản văn hóa phong phú
tip: “Giàu cái gì” dùng rich in, không dùng rich of.

senses.en: To have information or understanding about something
To be familiar with a person, place, or thing

ex.en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.

tip: Quá khứ knew, quá khứ phân từ known; thường không dùng thì tiếp diễn.

senses.en: A child of your aunt or uncle

ex.en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
Children who regularly spend time with their cousins may develop strong family bonds beyond their immediate household.

col: a first cousin｜anh chị em họ
a distant cousin｜anh chị em họ xa
a younger cousin｜anh chị em họ nhỏ tuổi
tip: Không phân biệt họ nội hay ngoại, giới tính hay tuổi tác; cần thì nói thêm.

senses.en: The eleventh month of the year.

ex.en: We are moving into our new flat in November.
The university plans to launch its new scholarship programme in November, allowing more international students to apply.

tip: Tên tháng viết hoa chữ cái đầu; trước tháng dùng in, trước ngày cụ thể dùng on.

senses.zh: quán cà phê; quán ăn nhỏ
senses.en: A small place serving drinks and light meals.

ex.en: We shared a sandwich at the cafe beside the station.
A neighbourhood cafe can strengthen community ties by providing a welcoming space for residents to meet.

col: outdoor cafe｜quán cà phê ngoài trời
local cafe｜quán cà phê gần đây
tip: Cũng viết là café; thường phục vụ đồ uống và bữa ăn nhẹ.

senses.en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive

senses.zh: trực tiếp; biểu diễn trực tiếp
senses.en: broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded
alive rather than dead

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.

col: live a healthy life｜sống lành mạnh
tip: Động từ đọc /lɪv/; tính từ và trạng từ chỉ trực tiếp đọc /laɪv/.

senses.en: the female person or animal receiving an action

senses.zh: của cô ấy; của bà ấy
senses.en: belonging to or connected with a female person or animal

ex.en: I called her after lunch to arrange a walk.
When a student requests additional support, teachers should help her access appropriate learning resources.

tip: her có thể làm tân ngữ hoặc đứng trước danh từ chỉ sở hữu; hers đứng độc lập.

senses.en: moving or acting fast, without much delay
taking only a short time

ex.en: Her quick reaction stopped the glass from falling.
A quick response to reports of water pollution can prevent serious damage to nearby ecosystems.

col: quick to react｜phản ứng nhanh nhạy
tip: Trong văn phong trang trọng, bổ nghĩa cho hành động nên dùng trạng từ quickly.

senses.en: the eighth month of the year

ex.en: We usually visit our grandparents by the sea in August.
Tourist destinations often experience increased demand in August, putting pressure on local transport and accommodation.

tip: Tên tháng viết hoa chữ cái đầu; trước tháng dùng in, trước ngày cụ thể dùng on.

senses.en: a country in central Europe

ex.en: My cousin moved to Germany to study engineering.
Germany has invested in renewable energy as part of its efforts to reduce dependence on fossil fuels.

col: travel to Germany｜đi du lịch Đức
made in Germany｜sản xuất tại Đức
tip: Germany là tên nước; German có thể chỉ tiếng Đức, người Đức hoặc thuộc nước Đức.

senses.en: A container made from flexible material, used for carrying things.
To put something into a bag.

ex.en: She put the apples in a reusable bag.
Charging customers for plastic bags can encourage shoppers to adopt more environmentally responsible habits.

col: a reusable bag｜túi dùng lại nhiều lần
pack a bag｜thu xếp hành lý
tip: a bag of theo sau là thứ đựng bên trong, như a bag of rice.

senses.en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.

tip: Nói play tennis, không có mạo từ; cây vợt là racket.

senses.en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet.
An animal belonging to the same family as lions.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
Keeping pet cats indoors can help protect native birds, particularly in areas with vulnerable wildlife populations.

tip: big cats chỉ các loài họ mèo lớn như sư tử, hổ.

senses.en: A particular area, position, or location.
To put something in a particular position.
A space available for someone to sit, study, or participate.

ex.en: This shady spot is a lovely place for a picnic.
Urban planners should place public facilities near residential areas to make essential services accessible to everyone.

col: take place｜diễn ra; được tổ chức
a university place｜suất nhập học đại học
tip: take place nghĩa là diễn ra hoặc được tổ chức, không dùng ở thể bị động.

senses.en: a one-piece garment with a top and a skirt

senses.zh: mặc quần áo; mặc đồ cho
senses.en: to put clothes on yourself or someone else
clothing of a particular type or worn for a particular occasion

ex.en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
Some employers require formal dress, while others allow staff to wear casual clothing at work.

col: dress code｜quy định về trang phục
tip: a dress là váy liền; get dressed là mặc quần áo xong.

senses.en: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long thin tail.
A handheld device for moving a pointer on a computer screen.

ex.en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
Using a mouse for long periods may cause wrist discomfort, so office workers should take regular breaks.

tip: Số nhiều của con chuột là mice; số nhiều của chuột máy tính có thể là mice hoặc mouses.

senses.en: a road vehicle with wheels, usually carrying a few people
one of the separate sections of a train

ex.en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.

tip: by car không có mạo từ; in a car cần mạo từ.

senses.en: the meal you eat at the start of the day

ex.en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
Schools that provide a healthy breakfast may help students concentrate better during morning lessons.

col: a balanced breakfast｜bữa sáng cân bằng dinh dưỡng
tip: Nói chung ăn sáng dùng have breakfast, không có mạo từ.

senses.zh: đánh vần; viết đúng chính tả
senses.en: To write or say the letters of a word in order.

senses.zh: một khoảng thời gian; một đợt
senses.en: A period during which a particular condition or activity continues.
Words or magic believed to have special powers.

ex.en: Could you spell your surname slowly for me, please?
A prolonged spell of dry weather can reduce crop yields and increase pressure on local water supplies.

col: spell a word｜đánh vần một từ
a dry spell｜một đợt hạn hán
a spell of illness｜một đợt ốm
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ trong tiếng Anh-Anh có thể là spelt hoặc spelled.

senses.en: to stop and hold something moving, or capture someone
to reach a bus, train, or plane in time
to become ill with an infectious disease

ex.en: Can you catch the ball with just one hand?
More frequent bus services would help commuters catch connecting trains without relying on private cars.

col: catch someone's attention｜thu hút sự chú ý của ai
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là caught; bị cảm dùng catch a cold.

senses.en: feel deep affection for someone or enjoy something very much

senses.zh: tình yêu; tình thương; niềm đam mê
senses.en: a strong feeling of affection or great enjoyment

ex.en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.

col: love of learning｜tình yêu học tập
love doing something｜thích làm việc gì
tip: love doing và love to do đều có thể có nghĩa thích làm gì.

senses.en: the number after three and before five

ex.en: We put four chairs around the kitchen table.
The research team compared four methods of reducing household energy use during the winter months.

tip: four là số đếm; thứ tự “thứ tư” dùng fourth.

senses.en: To let someone see something or demonstrate how something works.
To provide information or evidence that something is true.

senses.zh: buổi biểu diễn; chương trình; triển lãm
senses.en: A performance, programme, or public display intended for an audience.

ex.en: Please show me how to fold this paper bird.
Recent studies show that access to green spaces can improve mental wellbeing in urban populations.

col: show someone how to｜chỉ cho ai cách làm
show an improvement｜cho thấy sự cải thiện
a live show｜buổi biểu diễn trực tiếp
tip: Quá khứ showed, quá khứ phân từ thường là shown.

senses.en: In a higher position than something else.
Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard.

senses.zh: ở trên; ở phần trước (văn bản)
senses.en: In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.

col: above sea level｜trên mực nước biển
as mentioned above｜như đã nêu ở trên
tip: above chỉ vị trí cao hơn, không nhất thiết ngay phía trên và không có nghĩa là chạm vào.

senses.zh: người mới bắt đầu; người mới học
senses.en: someone who has just started learning or doing something

ex.en: This swimming class is perfect for a complete beginner.
Courses designed for beginners should provide clear guidance and regular opportunities to practise new skills.

col: a complete beginner｜người mới học từ đầu
suitable for beginners｜phù hợp cho người mới bắt đầu
a beginner's guide｜hướng dẫn nhập môn
tip: beginner là danh từ đếm được, ở số ít thường phải có từ hạn định.

senses.en: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.
Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need.
A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.

ex.en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.

col: cry with joy｜khóc vì vui sướng
a loud cry｜một tiếng kêu lớn
have a good cry｜khóc một trận
tip: Quá khứ cried, hiện tại phân từ crying; kêu lên thường dùng cry out.

senses.en: to obtain something by paying money for it
to believe an explanation or accept an idea

senses.zh: món đồ mua được; món hời
senses.en: something bought, especially something offering good value

ex.en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.

col: buy in bulk｜mua với số lượng lớn
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là bought; không viết buyed.

senses.en: Having little length, height, or duration.
Not having as much of something as is needed.

senses.zh: chưa đạt tới; dừng đột ngột
senses.en: Before reaching a target, or with a sudden stop.

ex.en: We took a short walk before dinner tonight.
Short training courses can help unemployed adults acquire practical skills without committing to several years of study.

col: in the short term｜trong thời gian ngắn
tip: short of nghĩa là thiếu; shortly thường có nghĩa “chẳng bao lâu nữa”.

senses.en: a group of words expressing a complete statement, question, or command
a punishment officially given by a court
to officially give someone a punishment in court

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to write one sentence about autumn.
Learning to vary sentence length can help students express complex ideas more clearly in academic essays.

tip: Tuyên án ai với hình phạt nào dùng sentence sb to sth.

senses.en: to have clothes, jewellery, or accessories on your body
to damage or become damaged through repeated use

senses.zh: sự hao mòn; sự mài mòn
senses.en: damage caused by regular use over time

ex.en: I always wear thick socks when the floor feels cold.
Encouraging employees to wear protective equipment can significantly reduce the risk of injuries in industrial workplaces.

col: wear and tear｜hao mòn thông thường
tip: wear nhấn mạnh trạng thái đang mặc, put on nhấn mạnh hành động; quá khứ là wore.

senses.en: a period of twenty-four hours
the part of each day when there is natural light
a particular period in the past or present

ex.en: We spent the whole day building sandcastles on the beach.
Shorter working days may improve employee wellbeing while allowing parents to spend more time with their children.

tip: every day nghĩa là mỗi ngày; everyday là tính từ nghĩa là hằng ngày.

senses.en: Schoolwork that students are asked to complete outside lessons.
Research or preparation done before making a decision.

ex.en: I finished my homework before dinner and went outside.
Schools should limit homework so that children have enough time for exercise and family activities.

col: do homework｜làm bài tập về nhà
do your homework｜chuẩn bị kỹ từ trước
tip: Danh từ không đếm được; một bài tập dùng a piece of homework.

senses.en: Of higher quality or more suitable than something else.
In a more effective or satisfactory way.
Less ill than before.

ex.en: This backpack is better than my old one.
Better public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in growing cities.

tip: Là dạng so sánh hơn của good và well, không nói more better.

senses.en: towards and then inside something
used to show the result of a change
interested in or enthusiastic about something

ex.en: The kitten jumped into the basket beside my chair.
Converting unused offices into affordable housing could help cities address shortages without expanding into surrounding countryside.

col: walk into a room｜bước vào phòng
be into music｜say mê âm nhạc
look into a problem｜điều tra vấn đề
tip: into nhấn mạnh quá trình đi vào; in thường chỉ ở bên trong.

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle moved by pushing pedals
to travel by bicycle

ex.en: I locked my bicycle outside the small bakery.
Travelling by bicycle can reduce urban air pollution while providing residents with regular physical exercise.

col: by bicycle｜đi lại bằng xe đạp
bicycle lane｜làn đường cho xe đạp
bicycle helmet｜mũ bảo hiểm xe đạp
tip: by bicycle không có mạo từ; ride a bicycle phải có mạo từ.

senses.en: To go to see a person or place.

senses.zh: chuyến thăm; chuyến tham quan; thời gian lưu lại
senses.en: An occasion when someone goes to see someone or somewhere.

ex.en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.

col: pay a visit to｜thăm; tham quan
a guided visit｜chuyến tham quan có hướng dẫn viên
tip: Động từ visit theo sau là tân ngữ trực tiếp; danh từ dùng a visit to.

senses.zh: mọi người; tất cả mọi người
senses.en: Every person in a group, or all people.

ex.en: Everyone brought a dish to share at the picnic.
Public libraries should ensure that everyone can access reliable information, regardless of income or educational background.

col: everyone else｜tất cả những người khác
everyone involved｜tất cả những người liên quan
tip: everyone đi với động từ số ít; every one nhấn mạnh từng người một.

senses.zh: sai; không đúng; không phù hợp
senses.en: Not correct, accurate, or suitable.
Not morally acceptable or fair.
In an incorrect way, or with an unsuccessful result.

ex.en: I took the wrong bus and ended up near the airport.
It is wrong to deny children educational opportunities simply because their families cannot afford school fees.

col: get something wrong｜hiểu sai việc gì
something is wrong with｜có điều gì đó không ổn
tip: go wrong là xảy ra trục trặc; trong wrong, chữ w đầu không đọc.

senses.en: a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution
a question requiring thought or calculation to answer

ex.en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.

col: solve a problem｜giải quyết vấn đề
tip: Vấn đề với cái gì dùng a problem with; giải pháp cho vấn đề dùng to.

senses.en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband

ex.en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.

col: uncle and aunt｜họ hàng như chú, bác, cậu, dượng
tip: uncle không phân biệt bên cha hay bên mẹ, cũng không phân biệt lớn hay nhỏ tuổi.

senses.en: An object shaped to open or close a particular lock.
Something essential for understanding or achieving something.
Extremely important to a situation or its outcome.

ex.en: I left my house key in my coat pocket.
Access to reliable information is key to helping consumers make informed decisions about their health.

col: a spare key｜chìa khóa dự phòng
the key to success｜chìa khóa thành công
a key factor｜yếu tố then chốt
play a key role｜đóng vai trò then chốt
tip: Trong the key to, to là giới từ, theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ.

senses.en: Use your voice to say words or communicate with someone.
Be able to communicate in a particular language.
Address an audience about a subject.

ex.en: Could I speak to you after the lesson?
Students who speak more than one language may find it easier to communicate across cultural boundaries.

col: speak in public｜phát biểu trước công chúng
speak to someone｜nói chuyện với ai
speak up｜lên tiếng; nêu ý kiến
tip: Quá khứ spoke, quá khứ phân từ spoken; trước tên ngôn ngữ không dùng giới từ.

senses.en: to look at written words and understand their meaning
to say written words aloud
to understand information shown by something

ex.en: I read a few pages before bed every night.
Children who read regularly often develop stronger language skills and a broader understanding of the world.

tip: Nguyên mẫu đọc /riːd/; quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đọc /red/.
